http_timeout_vs_event_loss.rule: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout transitions outbox to RETRY; event in local EventLog is NEVER deleted

temporary_connectivity_vs_task_failure.rule: Connectivity interruption leaves agent run paused in durable SQLite; resumes upon reconnection

sync_delayed_vs_sync_corrupted.rule: Jittered exponential backoff re-attempts sync; payload hash verification ensures zero corruption

tool_timeout_vs_tool_failure.rule: Tool bounded timeout marks execution as TIMEOUT ('outcome unknown') rather than claiming tool failed
